{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

# Check customer_segment distribution
dist = sales['customer_segment'].value_counts()
print(f'Customer segment distribution:\n{dist}')

# Check conversion rate by segment
conversion_by_segment = sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print(f'Conversion rate by segment:\n{conversion_by_segment}')

# Check the raw revenue column
print(f'First few revenue values: {sales["revenue"].head().tolist()}')"}
